description: Political cartoon meme captioned 'The wall the media is building in America.' A cartoon man on a ladder builds a brick wall, but instead of following the dotted border line between the words 'AMERICA' and 'MEXICO' the wall cuts through the middle of the word 'AMERICA', implying the media is dividing Americans rather than a border wall dividing the two countries.
text: The wall the media is building in America. AMERICA. MEXICO
flags: The cartoon's premise that the media is dividing America is the meme's claim, not a finding

description: 'Q proof' graphic titled 'Q+ is POTUS Aboard Air Force One'. It combines three elements linked by red dashed boxes and arrows: a CivMilAir flight-tracking tweet (7 Dec 2018) showing Air Force One (USAF VC-25A 92-9000) squawking callsign 'Q 0' over West Virginia; Q drop 2563 (7 Dec 2018) linking that tweet and asking where the '+' is on a mobile phone when dialing; and an iPhone keypad screenshot highlighting that the '0' key carries the '+'. The graphic claims this proves the 'Q+' signature is President Trump.

description: Composite graphic: a photograph of New England Patriots owner Robert Kraft in a suit holding the Vince Lombardi Trophy at a Super Bowl celebration, with an inset 8chan screenshot of Q drop No.5295136 (02/20/19) overlaid at bottom. The drop, replying to >>5294864, claims '[AS][SDNY][MW]' are keeping an ‘insurance’ scheme going post-Mueller and says coming events 'Will make the Super Bowl look like a puppy show' — the juxtaposition implies a link between that line and Kraft.
flags: The drop's claims about [AS][SDNY][MW] and an 'insurance' scheme are the Q post's assertions, unverified
A few reply-link numbers at the right edge of the screenshot are cut off and not transcribed
The implied connection between the drop and Robert Kraft is the collage creator's interpretation

description: Screenshot of a passage from an official-style report (consistent with the June 2018 DOJ Inspector General report on the FBI's Clinton email investigation) describing FBI executive Coleman's October 4 journal notes about the Anthony Weiner laptop case. The notes list Weiner texting a 15-year-old, a federal search warrant for his devices, thousands of emails found in initial laptop analysis, 'Hillary Clinton & Foundation', and 'Crime Against Children' — the word 'Children' is highlighted in yellow. The following paragraph relays Coleman's explanation that the notes likely reflect a morning briefing from the Criminal Investigative Division.
text: Coleman told us that he kept regularly took notes in a journal. Coleman's notes from October 4 contained the following entry:. (1) Anthony Wiener [sic]. (2) [Unrelated]. (3) Wiener [sic] – texting 15 yo – Sexually Explicit. 9/26 – Federal SW – IPhone/IPAD/Laptop. Initial analysis of laptop – thousands emails. Hillary Clinton & Foundation. Crime Against Children. We asked Coleman about these notes and he told us that, given their placement in his notebook, the notes would most likely represent information he was briefed on first thing in the morning by his subordinates in the Criminal Investigative Division. Coleman stated that he may have passed this information to other FBI executives after the morning briefing with the Director, but he could not remember if that occurred here.
flags: Source document not shown in the image; identification as the DOJ IG report is inferred from content
The identification of 'Coleman' as FBI executive Randall Coleman is inferred from context, not stated in the visible excerpt
The notes' contents are quoted claims from a briefing record, not established findings
